# Strikethrough


## strikethrough

```````````````````````````````` example
~~delete me
.
<p>~~delete me</p>
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
~~delete me~~
.
<p><del>delete me</del></p>
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
~~delete me~~~
.
<p>~~delete me~~~</p>
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
~~delete me\~~~
.
<p><del>delete me~</del></p>
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
~~delete \~\~ me~~
.
<p><del>delete ~~ me</del></p>
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
~~delete [me~~](/)
.
<p><del>delete [me</del>](/)</p>
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
~~[hello](/)~~
.
<p><del><a href="/">hello</a></del></p>
````````````````````````````````

## strikethrough code span

```````````````````````````````` example
~~before `x~~y` after~~
.
<p><del>before <code>x~~y</code> after</del></p>
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
~~before ``x~~`y`` after~~
.
<p><del>before <code>x~~`y</code> after</del></p>
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
~~before `x~~y` after
.
<p>~~before <code>x~~y</code> after</p>
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
~~before \`x~~y`
.
<p><del>before `x</del>y`</p>
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
~~before `x~~
.
<p><del>before `x</del></p>
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
~~[label](a`b)~~ text ` after~~
.
<p><del><a href="a%60b">label</a></del> text ` after~~</p>
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
~~![img](a`b)~~ text ` after~~
.
<p><del><img src="a%60b" alt="img" /></del> text ` after~~</p>
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
~~[label](<a`b>)~~ text ` after~~
.
<p><del><a href="a%60b">label</a></del> text ` after~~</p>
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
~~[label](u "t`t")~~ text ` after~~
.
<p><del><a href="u" title="t`t">label</a></del> text ` after~~</p>
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
~~<http://a.b/c`d>~~ text ` after~~
.
<p><del><a href="http://a.b/c%60d">http://a.b/c`d</a></del> text ` after~~</p>
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
~~<span title="a`b">x</span>~~ text ` after~~
.
<p><del><span title="a`b">x</span></del> text ` after~~</p>
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
~~[label`](u)~~ text ` after~~
.
<p><del>[label<code>](u)~~ text </code> after</del></p>
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
~~a](b`c)~~ text ` after~~
.
<p><del>a](b<code>c)~~ text </code> after</del></p>
````````````````````````````````
